description: Meets all timelines for menus and ordering.

Creates a farm to table culture in the café at Saint Joseph's College by utilizing the college's farms produce and livestock as well as creating business relationships with local farms, artisans, and other family owned companies.
Plans and prepares food for parties, holiday meals, luncheons, special functions, and other events.
Prices all menu and catering items, specifying portion and prep quantities while adhering to food, and sustainability guidelines.
Ensures that food cost meets budgetary goals each week in all operations by establishing purchasing specifications, product storage and usage requirements and waste control procedures.
Catered special events for the board of the college, weddings, and other events from 10-1200 people.
Instructed chefs in the preparation, cooking, garnishing and presentation of food.
Hires, trains, and supervises the daily conduct of the Chefs and Sous Chefs.
Cooked appetizers, soups, sandwiches, and all fried foods.
Cook everything from appetizers to fried food, to the main dishes.
In charge of creating my own specials every day.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate, serving as an Executive Chef with extensive experience in menu planning and operations management, has demonstrated a strong dedication to culinary arts through various positions where they managed over 20 employees and organized events including weddings and banquets. Their passion for using locally sourced seasonal ingredients is evident in their popular daily specials development, which highlights their skills in kitchen management and cost efficiency within the food industry. The candidate's leadership role at Saint Joseph's College showcases an ability to foster a farm-to-table culture, managing both business relationships with local farms and creating sustainable menus that align with sustainability goals. Their background includes notable accomplishments such as featured articles in Plate Magazine and participation in prestigious events like the Northern New England Home and Garden Show, further emphasizing their commitment to culinary excellence.
